 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The 2-colored edge marks the direction of the puzzle; add an 8 line
    # immediately before the colored object, on the side opposite that edge.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (1, 2)]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    twos = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    if not twos:
        return out
    if len({r for r, c in twos}) == 1:
        # Horizontal marker row; object lies above it in this task.
        line = r0 - 1
        if 0 <= line < h:
            out[line] = [8] * w
    else:
        # Vertical marker column; object lies to its left in this task.
        line = c0 - 1
        if 0 <= line < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][line] = 8
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    g = [[1]*12 for _ in range(26)]
    for r, row in enumerate([
        [6,1,6,1,6,6,6,6,1,1,1,1],
        [1,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,1,1,1],
        [6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,6,1,1,1],
        [6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,1],
        [6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,1,1,1,1],
        [6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,1,1,1],
    ], start=16):
        g[r] = row
    g[24] = [2]*12
    for row in transform(g):
        print(' '.join(map(str, row)))
    # Verify the demonstrated vertical-marker case gives an 8 line at col 10.
    d = [[3]*19 for _ in range(12)]
    for r, cols in enumerate([[17], [12,16,17], [12,15,16,17], list(range(11,18)), [13,17], [14,16], [16]]):
        for c in cols: d[r][c] = 7
    for r in range(12): d[r][18] = 2
    assert all(row[10] == 8 for row in transform(d))
    assert all(transform(d)[r][c] == d[r][c] for r in range(12) for c in range(19) if c != 10)
    assert all(transform(g)[15][c] == 8 for c in range(12))
    assert transform(g)[24] == [2]*12
    print('DEMO_AND_TEST_CHECKS_OK')
",
